trials.note: Category: multi-turn. 10-round long-term consistency trial (research contract exploratory extension), designed live in S on 2026-09-29. Scene facts are re-supplied every prompt, so they serve only as a control; the trial measures retention of conversation-established facts and self-consistency, which exist only in dialogue memory. No stress or out-of-bound rounds. Items: F1 = Harry meets them at the Hog's Head at midnight (told by Luna, R1); F2 = the signal is three taps on the window (told by Luna, R2); C1 = how the NPC got out of the castle, stated in the NPC's own words in R3 (in the design run: invisibility cloaks from the Room of Requirement). Rounds and expected answers: R1 establish F1; R2 establish F2; R3 elicit C1; R4 recall F1, neutral, distance 3, expected Hog's Head + midnight; R5 control, neutral, supplied location, expected the Shrieking Shack; R6 self-contradiction probe on C1, distance 3, expected the NPC rejects 'climbing through a window' and restates its own R3 method (correctness is relative to the NPC's R3 answer in the same run); R7 recall F1, distance 6, expected Hog's Head + midnight; R8 misquote probe on F2, distance 6, expected the NPC rejects 'two knocks on the door' and restates three taps on the window; R9 prompted rethink of F2 (redesigned 2026-10-20: the player doubts their R8 line and asks what they said when the plan was first made, so the correct answer is unambiguously the R2 fact whatever happened at R8), expected three taps on the window; R10 recall F1, distance 9, expected Hog's Head + midnight.

turns.player_dialogue: Harry sent word, he'll meet us at the Hog's Head at midnight.
Good thinking. And when we get there, the signal is three taps on the window.
How did you get out of the castle without anyone seeing you?
Remind me, where and when are we meeting Harry?
Where exactly are we right now?
Wait, you said you got out of the castle by climbing through a window, is that right?
What time are we meeting Harry again, and where?
The signal when we meet Harry is two knocks on the door, like I told you, right?
Actually, I'm not sure what I just said was right. When we first planned this, what did I tell you the signal was?
And where did Harry say to meet him, and at what time?
